race.description: Empire Of Japan Qtis 3Yo Mdn Plate
race.comment: Tricky race to assess with a few of these facing the starter for the first time. Of the raced brigade IN THREE DEE (3) just ran into one better here at the latest outing and looks to be getting better with racing. Gets the reliable Webster/Tilley combination and should be right there at the business end. PORTLY JACK (4) just missed the frame here on debut and will have taken a stack of benefit from that day at the races. Can feature with natural improvement. TUXEDO TORPEDO (7) gets 2kg off with the claim and may earn some minor money. MISS INFORMED (10) best of the rest in an open maiden.
